mods.title: 4-Deck Waveforms
mods.description:
Choose 2 DECK, 2/4 DECK or four native waveform lanes.
Set smoothing here: Native Height 30 is the default and
recommended mode for smooth four-deck playback.
Lane order and track overviews can also be changed.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: TYTO's Side Screen View
mods.description:
Show the selected deck and master waveforms on each
side screen, with artwork and track information.
The master player uses an orange MASTER PLAYER badge.
Follows Light Mode and Hide Track Name settings.

versions.changelog: - CDJ-3000 style side screens with artwork, track info and a MASTER PLAYER badge on the master deck.

mods.title: Side Screen Browser
mods.description:
Hold Deck Select for one second to browse USB playlists
and tracks on that side. Choose a control scheme below.
Beat Loop: turn to scroll, press to open, hold to go back.
Closes after loading. Enable native LOAD LOCK for safety.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: Stems
mods.description:
Control prepared stems independently for each deck.
Use compatible pre-generated stem files on the USB.
Enable the mod, load a prepared track and use the
on-screen stem controls to mute or restore parts.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: Light Mode
mods.description:
Use a light interface for bright environments.
Choose the normal or blue waveform palette below.
Also updates compatible TYTO side-screen waveforms.

versions.changelog: - The bottom mixer and MIC panels and the deck input pop-up menu stay light.

mods.title: Quick USB
mods.description:
Show named, colour-coded USB shortcuts above the
waveforms. Tap a drive to open its native browser.
The active source is highlighted; tapping does not
load a track into a deck.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: Beat FX Sidebar
mods.description:
Keep effect name, BPM, beat and time visible beside
the waveforms in all layouts. Native popups stay above it.
Enable this sidebar to use the FX Frequency controls
and the optional Gate Cues quick toggle.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: FX Frequency
mods.description:
Choose LOW, ALL or HIGH to select the frequency range
used by the filter-assisted Beat FX controls.
Beat FX Sidebar must be enabled to show the buttons.
This does not add an independent three-band master EQ.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: FX Knob Selector
mods.description:
Turn Beat FX TIME to select MIC / 3 / 1 / 2 / 4 / MASTER.
Choose how many detents move to the next target.
Hold SHIFT while turning TIME to change effect time.
The FX SELECT knob keeps its normal function.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: Gate Cues
mods.description:
On paused decks, hold a hot cue to audition it.
Releasing a cue stops and returns to its cue point.
Press PLAY while holding to latch normal playback.
The optional quick toggle needs Beat FX Sidebar.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: Slip Mode
mods.description:
Replace each deck's Slip Reverse control with Slip.
Playback continues in the background during scratching;
release to resume at the continuing playback position.
Flashing deck LEDs indicate that Slip is active.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: Playlist Editing
mods.description:
Edit track order from the main-screen playlist browser.
Hold the main browse knob on a playlist track to open
the editing controls. Changes apply to the USB library;
keep a backup of your export before editing.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: Party Mode
mods.description:
Animate the jog-wheel ring LEDs with colour effects.
Choose an effect and transition speed below.
Disabling restores normal deck colours.
Flashing effects may affect photosensitive users.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: Hide Track Name
mods.description:
Hide track names on the main display and compatible
TYTO side screens. Use the eye controls to reveal or
hide names while keeping the other deck information.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: Continuous Zone Playback
mods.description:
Automatically start the next track on the deck assigned
to ZONE playback. Choose the ZONE assignment using
the normal controls. Disable this mod to restore
the stock continuation behavior.

versions.changelog: - First version in the online mod catalog.

mods.title: Side Screen Waveforms (Legacy)
mods.description:
The original side-screen view: the deck's waveform, cues, loops,
BPM, key and time on each side screen.
Requires Side Screen Browser. TYTO's Side Screen View is the newer view.

versions.changelog: - The original side-screen waveform view, available as its own mod.
